text: With m2 fixed, seed 20 closes the N=64 to N=128 force gap to 0.015 by step 6000, but seed 21 stays 0.103 below. Seed 21's N=64 force peaks at layer 1 (the distance layer), and its N=128 force peaks at layer 2. Compared at the same layer (e.g. layer 4 in both arms), does seed 21's gap shrink to the size of seed 20's? That would show whether the remaining N=128 deficit is confined to a layer-1 read of 1/r^2.
